# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

XAT YEEKAXNEEK AX DIKEE ANKOW YOO XATYEEKLEEYET'IN. KHA KASAKOOWOO EE YA SCHKAKAWK. XAT YEEKAXNEEK YA YEEDAT KLETIH XAT YOO TSEEN. YEE YA KULH SENA, KHA XAT KANISHKEEDEL KA YEE ANKAW.
WE EE CHEEKLEINAK DIKEE ANKAW VEE SKANU YA KETH YEDASHEE, KA CHEEWEAH-SKEEDANEEK.
